name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Ultra-fast audio extraction: eliminated 70% stalling and wait times with direct audio stream muxing.
Expandable quality bottom sheet: drag up to full screen or tap to toggle fullscreen view.
Fixed bottom sheet clipping and navigation bar overlap on all Android devices.
Reliable back gesture handling: seamlessly closes or collapses popup bottom sheet.
